about: The seven scheduled tasks of story S10 (auth.db cron_prompt_jobs) with the template every run answer is built from (cron_runs.answer_enc). A run picks its case from the data of its due time, then one wording of that case in turn, so two neighbouring runs never share a wording. The first line is what the owner's Inbox shows.

briefs.about: The brief is a hidden job per manager (slug brief-<manager id>, name 'Brief', the product's brief.md as its instruction, no schedule). A brief is at most three lines, each starting '- ', each one sentence of at most 20 words. 'at_t' is the brief each of the four reads on the morning of T: the first run of T's brief day. 'bank' builds every other brief: a point is used when its condition holds at the run's instant, most important first, at most three.
